name: Kaynes Technology India

headline.text: Q1 FY27: revenue ₹946 cr (+40.6% YoY), PAT ₹56 cr (−25.3% YoY).
Trailing twelve months: revenue ₹3,899 cr, EBITDA ₹609 cr (15.6% margin), PAT ₹346 cr.

claims.text: Revenue compounded at 53.9% a year over FY21–FY26 (₹420 cr → ₹3,626 cr).
FY26 revenue growth of 33.2% was the slowest in 5 years.
EBITDA margin expanded by 84 bps over FY23–FY26 (15.1% → 15.9%).
PAT compounded at 105.2% a year over FY21–FY26, ahead of revenue.

citations.excerpt: Profit after tax for the year 3,638.90 2,934.33
citations.section: Notes to the consolidated financial statements

claims.text: Debt-to-equity was 0.19 at FY26 end (0.16 at FY23).
Borrowings rose 5.9× from ₹155 cr to ₹913 cr over FY23–FY26.
Over the last 5 years, operating cash flow totalled −₹615 cr against ₹977 cr of reported profit — operations consumed cash rather than generating it.
Free cash flow (as computed by screener.in) was positive in 0 of the last 5 years, −₹3,288 cr in total.
Capex over the last 5 years was ₹2,673 cr, while operations consumed ₹615 cr (derived as operating cash flow − free cash flow).
Cash conversion cycle lengthened from 162 to 193 days over FY23–FY26.
Return on capital employed was 13% in FY26 (22% in FY23).

statements.quote: As far as OSAT and PCB is concerned, we already told from third quarter the revenue starts in both the business, and we have committed a full year revenue of totally INR500 crores between both, INR450 to INR500 crores, which is what we are targeting at this point in time, we are on the target.

statements.speaker: Viral Shah
statements.quote: At the start of the year, sir, we had guided that we are looking to close the year with revenues of INR4,500 crores, which was subsequently toned down to INR4,000 crores, and we ended the year with close to INR3,600 crores of revenue, sir.
statements.assessmentNote: ₹3,626 cr reported — 81% of the ₹4,500 cr promised

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: Giving a guidance of INR4,500 crores is almost 55% growth over the previous year.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: I think these are the 2 things that while we have delivered about 33% growth in revenue and 39% growth in the bottom line, we sincerely understand and appreciate that the guidance what we have given, we could not meet.

statements.speaker: Viral Shah
statements.quote: But sir, OCF INR600 crores of negative, I think that is a bigger disappointment, especially when you kind of guided that you will be just about neutral or slightly negative, sir.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: It is not that we are not giving a guidance for the revenue.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: We are not only giving guidance for the revenue numbers.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: When we are saying that the industry in India, the GDP growth is at 8%, the EMS space where we are playing has grown at about 18% last year or is expected to grow in this year 16% to 18%.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: But exactly, we don't want to put the number because you see, for example, the December projection of automotive industry was a mid-double-digit growth for this year, whereas the latest prediction phase, it will be a single-digit higher or lower double digits, which may impact on the offtake of the product.

statements.speaker: N. Muthukumar
statements.quote: For the next year, while the INR971 crores of sales, what we did this year, in absolute numbers, we may remain same or slightly up or down, that's not a question, but almost 50% of the business will be in the old model and the rest will come in the new model.

statements.speaker: Achal Lohade
statements.quote: Sir, just to expand the previous question, if you could talk from a production value perspective, the earlier guidance of INR1,000 crores for OSAT, INR500 crores for PCB.

statements.speaker: Sonali Salgaonkar
statements.quote: And secondly, the orders which are deferred, you mentioned in your television interview this morning that there is a deferral in the railways Kavach order worth INR3 billion, which is why you have brought down your revenue guidance as well.

overview.excerpt: Kaynes Technology India Limited (‘Kaynes’, ‘Our Company’ or ‘We’) is a leading end-to-end IoT solutions-integrated electronics manufacturing company in India, offering comprehensive capabilities across the entire ESDM value chain from new product design and engineering to manufacturing and lifecycle support.

Kaynes Technology India Limited ('Kaynes', 'KTIL', 'the Company,' or ‘We’) is a leading provider of end- to-end, IoT-enabled Integrated Electronics Manufacturing Services (IEMS), with capabilities spanning the full electronics value chain.

The platform is also expanding into smart water metering, enabling a unified multi-utility digital ecosystem across electricity and water infrastructure. GridCrest’s Products, Solutions and Services to Grab this Opportunity GridCrest’s leadership anticipated the shift from smart meter supply to integrated digital utility platforms, repositioning the company around the complete utility value chain.

evidence.excerpt: The Group operates predominantly in one business segment of Electronics Manufacturing Services and accordingly primary reporting disclosures for business segment are not applicable.
